values.note: recreation.gov charges $18 a single site, $32 a double, $15 a walk-to tent site; the Forest Service page (last updated June 2, 2026) still lists $16 single, $28 double, $13 walk-in. Limit two vehicles per single site; a daily fee for extra vehicles.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234132/rates (Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 18, double STANDARD NONELECTRIC 32, WALK TO 15) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234132 (notice 'Limit two vehicles per single site; a daily fee is charged for extra vehicles') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/spruce-knob-lake-campground ('Single Site: $16 per night', 'Double Site: $28 per night', 'Walk-in Single Site: $13 per night', last updated June 2, 2026), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov up to 11 months ahead and until 4 days before arrival; recreation.gov also says 'This campground has first-come, first-served sites'. Reservations carry a 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimum. 14-day stay limit. Concession-run (American Land & Leisure).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234132 (rules: reservationWindow 11 Months, reservationCutOff 4 day(s) prior to arrival, minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3; notice 'This campground has first-come, first-served sites'; facility email comments@AmericanLL.com, link 'Forest Service Concessionaire: American Land and Leisure') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/spruce-knob-lake-campground ('Maximum length of stay is 14 days.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234132 ('No electric hookups are available.') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (every site STANDARD NONELECTRIC or WALK TO), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 28 standard and 2 double units with paved spurs, plus 10 walk-in tent sites (recreation.gov's catalog lists 12 walk-to). The catalog takes RVs and trailers at 29 sites, all to 30 ft, one of them pull-through, the rest back-in. Gatewood Group Campground (one group site) is separate.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234132 ('28 standard camping units, 2 double camping units, and 10 walk in camping units with fire rings, lantern posts, picnic tables and paved spurs') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234132 (29 STANDARD NONELECTRIC with RV/TRAILER equipment, Max Vehicle Length 30, one Pull-Through; 1 tent-only standard; 12 WALK TO), read 2026-10-21

values.note: recreation.gov: five accessible single-toilet vault restrooms and 'a solar-powered system for drinking water'; firewood sold on site. The Forest Service page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site' and 'Potable water is not available at this site', so drinking water is not recorded.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234132 ('The campground has accessible vault toilets and a solar-powered system for drinking water', 'five single-toilet vault restrooms all of which are accessible', 'Firewood is for sale on-site') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/spruce-knob-lake-campground ('Restrooms are not available at this site.', 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234132 (notice: 'Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 opening: April 17 ('dates are subject to change based on local weather conditions'); no closing date published.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation (2026 Recreation Opening Dates: 'Spruce Knob Lake Campground — 4/17'), read 2026-10-21

summary: recreation.gov + Forest Service page: confirmed $18 (rec.gov; FS page still says $16), no electric; added rec.gov booking (11 months to 4 days ahead, some first-come sites, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 14-day limit), 30 RV units to 30 ft with one pull-through, vault toilets, senior-pass discount. No road alert for FR 112 / FR 1. Season: not year-round, 2026 opening April 17 (no closing date). AWH note kept.
